put_clothes_in_closet:
def policy():
    walk("bedroom")
    find("clothespile")
    if grab("clothespile").status != "succeeded":
        return False
    find("closet")
    closets = [obj for obj in get_visible_objects() if obj.name == "closet"]
    if not closets:
        return False
    opened = [obj for obj in closets if "OPEN" in (get_object_states(obj) or frozenset())]
    target = opened[0] if opened else closets[0]
    if not ensure_open(target):
        return False
    return putin("clothespile", target).status == "succeeded"
